google-takeout.title: Google Takeout exports
google-takeout.notes: Each Takeout archive is one source collection; original files preserved as artifacts.

google-contacts.title: Google Contacts
google-contacts.notes: Third-party PII bodies are NOT stored, honouring the ecosystem's ratified stance (MPI D1) until an explicit owner decision reverses this for OTH Knowledge. Pointers and non-PII metadata only.

claude.title: Claude conversation exports
claude.notes: Chat export archived in OTH Master (oth.db, source_provider='claude'). Statements extracted from these conversations enter as CLAIMS asserted by 'claude:user' or 'claude:assistant' — never as facts. Trust tier is model-output even for user turns, because the provenance is an export and not a verified owner report.

deepseek.title: DeepSeek conversation exports
deepseek.notes: Chat export archived in OTH Master (oth.db, source_provider='deepseek'). Same claim-only rule as the claude class.

chatgpt.title: ChatGPT conversation exports
chatgpt.notes: Registered ahead of use. No ChatGPT export has been imported into oth.db as of 2026-08-30, and adapters/chatgpt has not been validated against a real export. Same claim-only rule as the claude class.

google-other.title: Other Google data discovered during ingestion
google-other.notes: Catch-all for Google source systems without a dedicated class yet; promote to a dedicated class before bulk ingestion.

mythos-repo.title: Mythos repository documentation and history
mythos-repo.notes: Pointer-first: repository remains the source of truth; ingest for retrieval, never as a replacement canon.

owner-report.title: Owner-reported verified facts
owner-report.notes: First-party statements from the owner (e.g. infrastructure verification reports).

external-provider.title: Future external providers
external-provider.notes: Fail-closed default for unclassified external systems; register a dedicated class with an explicit policy before content ingestion.
